top.name: Pivotal Moment
top.rules_text: Look at the top 3 cards. Put 1 back on top; the rest go to the bottom. Gain 1 Foresight.

bottom.name: Later
bottom.rules_text: Foretell: set the top card of your deck aside. Next turn it's in your hand and costs 1 less.

upgrades.description: A wider glimpse; a cheaper future.

changes.value: Foretell: set the top card of your deck aside. Next turn it's in your hand and costs 2 less.
